recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the /metadata mode contract or the TerminologyCapabilities resource lifecycle.
issue_request: FHIR-17106 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request asking for a specific endpoint to retrieve the server-specific TerminologyCapabilities resource, analogous to the CapabilityStatement /metadata endpoint, with resolution to apply the GF#14444 /metadata mode mechanism and document it against TerminologyCapabilities.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 8df77e615e, migrated from svn r14742, which added the TerminologyCapabilities introduction text for GET [base]/metadata?mode=terminology. The related GF#14444 commit 81544e1ec1 added the /metadata mode parameter and terminology mode row to the RESTful API capabilities interaction.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists TerminologyCapabilities as an active build resource. Current source/http.html documents GET [base]/metadata{?mode=[mode]} and says mode=terminology returns TerminologyCapabilities, while source/terminologycapabilities/terminologycapabilities-introduction.xml repeats the direct GET [base]/metadata?mode=terminology request. Zulip discussion supports the need for a known endpoint and later confirms the R4-era mode=terminology behavior; Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the build-scoped source already satisfies FHIR-17106 and no source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: This Published/Persuasive CapabilityStatement issue supplied the /metadata mode mechanism used by FHIR-17106.
This later FHIR-us-qm issue relies on metadata?mode=terminology for a measure terminology service, but it is outside FHIR core and was not reconciled here.
